SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree damage is
likely.

This dangerous storm will be near...
Johnson-Sauk Trail State Park around 1005 PM CDT.

This also includes Johnson-Sauk Trail State Recreation Area.

This includes Interstate 80 in Illinois between mile markers 34 and
35.
properties.instruction:
TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest
floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows. If you are outdoors, in a
mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter
and protect yourself from flying debris.

properties.title: Flood Advisory issued August 9 at 6:07PM MST until August 9 at 9:00PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
* WHAT...Small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall is
expected.

* WHERE...South Central Graham County in southeastern Arizona...

* WHEN...Until 900 PM MST.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 607 PM MST, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. This will cause small stream flooding. Between 0.7
and 1 inch of rain has fallen.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Safford, Thatcher, Solomon, San Jose, Roper Lake State Park,
Safford Regional Airport and Swift Trail Junction.
- This includes the following highways...
Route 191 between mile markers 111 and 136. Route 70 between mile
markers 335 and 352.
